authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W04-W07 accepted; W08/provider prerequisites as needed
defaults.mission: Lead/customer/conversation lifecycle, qualification/scoring, nurture/sales/customer success and next-best-action with deterministic/cache/template fast paths and governed handling for complex/high-value cases.
sources: - n8n W10 sanitized references (167 patterns) and TOCA CRM/omnichannel/measurement references

tasks.title: W10-00 - Revenue/CRM Coordination & Domain Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W04-W08 outputs required by revenue flows.
2. Freeze canonical domain boundaries for lead, conversation, opportunity/customer lifecycle and read models.
3. Define capability plan/route ownership and external-provider dependencies.
4. Define business-result/evidence metrics and publication barriers for W11 consumers.
5. Create risk/premortem for stale CRM state, duplicate outreach, tenant leakage and automated sales actions.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement social-provider transport, Meta/Google Ads or authority semantics.

tasks.title: W10-A - Lead, Customer & Conversation Lifecycle
actions: 1. Define lifecycle states/transitions for lead/customer/conversation entities using canonical IDs.
2. Model provenance/source and tenant isolation.
3. Handle duplicate/merge/closed/reopened scenarios deterministically.
4. Emit W03 events for material state transitions.
5. Add transition/property tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create parallel identity/tenant primitives.

tasks.title: W10-B - Qualification & Scoring
actions: 1. Implement deterministic and model-assisted qualification/scoring with explicit features/provenance.
2. Separate score/confidence from authority and irreversible actions.
3. Define thresholds/escalation policies as domain rules, not permission.
4. Support recalculation when source facts change.
5. Add calibration/edge-case tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not auto-authorize outreach/spend based on score.

tasks.title: W10-C - CRM Persistence & Read Models
actions: 1. Implement domain persistence/read models on W03 durable foundation.
2. Support idempotent writes, optimistic/version checks and event-driven projections.
3. Maintain tenant/account boundaries and provenance.
4. Provide query surfaces needed by next-best-action and W11 lead handoff.
5. Add replay/rebuild tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not duplicate W03 generic persistence framework.

tasks.title: W10-D - Nurture, Sales & Customer Success Flows
actions: 1. Model nurture/sales/customer-success state machines and task generation.
2. Use deterministic templates/workflows for known safe steps.
3. Require W07/W08 governed execution for external messages/actions.
4. Bound cadence/retries and prevent duplicate outreach.
5. Add cancellation/opt-out/consent tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not perform direct provider writes or bypass consent/current policy.

tasks.title: W10-E - Next-Best-Action Planning
actions: 1. Define next-best-action candidate generation from verified CRM/context facts.
2. Use W04 CapabilityPlan and W05 routing where reasoning is needed.
3. Carry rationale/provenance/budget/confidence without converting them to authority.
4. Return abstain/escalate when evidence is insufficient.
5. Add deterministic/benchmark scenarios.
tasks.forbidden: Do not mint ActionIntent for unsafe side effects without policy/authority flow.

tasks.title: W10-F - Fast Paths: Deterministic / Cache / Templates
actions: 1. Identify common low-risk high-frequency revenue tasks.
2. Route verified facts through deterministic/cache/template paths where sufficient.
3. Define freshness/invalidation and template versioning.
4. Escalate conflict/uncertainty/high-value cases to Governed Lane.
5. Measure latency/cost improvement without quality/safety regression.
tasks.ownership: W10 fast-path domain compositions using W04-W06.
tasks.forbidden: Do not bypass W07 for any external write.

tasks.title: W10-G - Revenue Integration & Business Outcome Evals
actions: 1. Run lead -> qualification -> next-best-action -> governed execution/evidence scenarios.
2. Test duplicate events, stale CRM state, consent changes, provider failures and human correction.
3. Link outcomes to business-result evidence suitable for W17/W18.
4. Run four Risk Gates and performance/economic budgets.
5. Publish W10 handoff for W11.
tasks.forbidden: Do not claim adaptive learning promotion before W17/W18.
